title: Nonhalting throughout a run prefix
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $S$ be a state type, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine with initial configuration $c$. If the machine is still in a state after $t$ steps, then it is still in a state after every number $u$ of steps with $u\le t$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a $k$-work-tape Turing machine over Boolean symbols with states in $S$
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x$
